label: Toy programme — an invented three-field demo (materials, acoustics, mechanics)
note: Invented demo. These fields stand for nothing real and cite no paper; they exist so a second programme has a graph of its own, with a path of two bridges.

fields.label: Toy materials (invented demo field)
anti_overreach: no claim about any real material

fields.label: Toy acoustics (invented demo field)
anti_overreach: no claim about hearing, listening or intervention

fields.label: Tissue mechanics literature
anti_overreach: no inference from a tissue measurement to a person's traits
no clinical claim from bench mechanics

bridges.junction: stress and strain quantities that may stand beside each other across the two literatures, at stated reliability
which stiffness quantities may stand beside which resonance quantities in the demo

stop.rule: demo stop: abandon at the date whatever the results look like

amendments.reason: pre-registered addition; old claim kept beside new
